claim: Breach of an Anton Piller Order
requested_remedy: Breach of an Anton Piller Order
parties: Defendant: KAM YUEN ELECTRONICS (1st Respondent) and WONG CHAK KA (2nd Respondent)

facts.F1: The case is related to an Anton Piller Order served on the 1st Respondent company, Kam Yuen Electronics, and its director, Wong Chak Ka (2nd Respondent).
facts.F2: The Order was served personally on the 2nd Respondent, with a penal notice indorsed.
facts.F3: The 2nd Respondent had the opportunity to read and understand the Order, which was in both English and Chinese.
facts.F4: The 2nd Respondent contacted his own solicitors, but did not take the opportunity to deal with the matter properly and in compliance with the Order.
facts.F5: The 2nd Respondent had 7 telephone conversations with his solicitors during the afternoon, but did not seek their advice on the Order.
facts.F6: The 2nd Respondent told the executing solicitor, Mr. Tang, that he was waiting for his own solicitors to arrive, but it turned out that the solicitors had no instructions to attend the office.
facts.F7: The executing solicitor, Mr. Tang, explained the Order to the 2nd Respondent, but the 2nd Respondent refused to allow the search and did not deliver up any documents.
facts.F8: The 2nd Respondent was aware of the facts that rendered them in breach of the Order.
facts.F9: The 2nd Respondent's actions were a deliberate attempt to stall the execution of the Order.
